metadata.title: Salasel — Learn with intention. Stay the course.
metadata.description: A focused learning platform with curated series, plus an optional browser extension that calms YouTube. They work together, and each stands on its own.

hero.hadith: Strive for what benefits you, seek help from God, and never give up.
hero.tagline: Learn with intention. Stay the course.

meaning.lead: The name holds both meanings: series that organise knowledge so you know where to begin, and chains that tie intention to practice so what you learn stays. That is what we build, for learning, awareness, and personal growth.
meaning.artworkAlt: A chain of interlocking links, lit in green, entering from the edge of the page.

app.lead: A place to return to instead of an endless feed: discover, focus, and keep your place.

points.discover: Discover curated series across education, awareness, and personal growth.
points.focus: Watch in a focused environment and track your progress.
points.keep: Bookmark what serves you and keep your own notes.
points.return: And always return to a clear learning path.

appPrivacy.metaDescription: How the Salasel app handles your data: no account, no tracking, and your learning kept in your browser.
appPrivacy.title: App Privacy Policy
appPrivacy.intro: Salasel is built to be used without handing over your data. This policy describes what the app does and does not collect. It uses plain, verifiable terms rather than broad promises.

noAccount.title: No account, no tracking
noAccount.body: Using Salasel does not require you to create an account. There is no analytics, no advertising, and no sale of your data. Ever.

onDevice.title: Your learning stays in your browser
onDevice.body: Your learning progress, preferences, and notes are stored in your own browser. They are not uploaded to a server we control as part of normal use.

feedback.title: Feedback you choose to send
feedback.body: If you fill in and submit the feedback form, the message you write is transmitted so we can read it. Nothing is sent unless you explicitly submit it.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.body: The project's source is open, so these claims can be verified in the code itself. You can read it, check it, or build on it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, the updated version will be published on this page with a new date.

extensionPrivacy.metaDescription: How the Salasel Chrome extension handles your data: it hides only what you choose, keeps notes in your browser, and cannot read your browser sync.
extensionPrivacy.title: Extension Privacy Policy
extensionPrivacy.intro: The Salasel extension is optional and works on YouTube to hide only the distractions you choose. This policy describes exactly what it does with your data.

noTracking.title: No account, no tracking
noTracking.body: The extension does not require an account, does not track your browsing, includes no analytics, and never sells your data.

onDevice.title: Preferences kept in your browser
onDevice.body: Your distraction toggles and notes are stored in your browser. They are not uploaded to a server we control as part of normal use.

sync.title: Sync you control
sync.body: Your extension preferences may use your browser account's built-in sync so they follow you between devices. That sync is controlled by your browser provider and your browser account. We cannot access that data.

permissions.title: What the extension can access
permissions.body: The extension runs on YouTube so it can hide the elements you turn off and show a way back to your Salasel series. It reads and changes the page only to do that, and only for the distractions you have switched on.

feedback.title: Feedback you choose to send
feedback.body: Any feedback is transmitted only when you explicitly submit it. Nothing is sent otherwise.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.body: The extension's source is open, so its behaviour can be verified directly in the code.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, the updated version will be published on this page with a new date.
